summary: USPH filed an 8-K announcing the acquisition of a twelve-clinic physical therapy practice effective July 1, 2026. USPH acquired a 67% equity interest with 33% retained by current owners. The practice generates ~112,000 annual visits and $12 million in annual revenue. No price per share, premium, or advisor was disclosed. The transaction is structured as a partial acquisition with ongoing owner involvement. Watch for clinic integration and state expansion strategy. No risk-arb angle due to lack of public target or deal premium.
